Vérifiez la distance

Instruction or query to verify the distance to a navigational object, other vessel, or danger, often using radar or visual bearings.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Vérifiez la distance?

In this glossary, Vérifiez la distance refers to: Instruction or query to verify the distance to a navigational object, other vessel, or danger, often using radar or visual bearings.

How is Vérifiez la distance used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Passerelle, vérifiez la distance au navire le plus proche sur l'avant bâbord et signalez si un risque de collision existe."

Why does Vérifiez la distance matter in maritime?

Vérifiez la distance matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Vérifiez la distance?

Vérifiez la distance is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Vérifiez la distance belong to?

In this glossary, Vérifiez la distance is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Instruction or query to verify the distance to a navigational object, other vessel, or danger, often using radar or visual bearings.

Operational example

Bridge, check range to the nearest vessel off port bow and advise if risk of collision exists.

Localized term

Vérifiez la distance

Localized example

Passerelle, vérifiez la distance au navire le plus proche sur l'avant bâbord et signalez si un risque de collision existe.
